messages:
zara_devex: Heads-up: starting an abbreviated publish window in 5m (23:30 UTC). Py & TS canaries scheduled. Please refrain from publish PR merges until we confirm.

publish-bot: publish-request received for @redwood/sdk-js (canary). job: canary-js-4145678901 queued.

mike_releases: quick FYI, we had a flake last week where a canary consumer pulled the canary via `pip install redwood-sdk==latest` and failed. Recommend pinning if anything looks off.

anita_eng: js canary looks good locally, but py build shows a minor metadata mismatch: `wheel metadata missing author_email`. upload succeeded though.

marta_docs: let's avoid cutting the changelog until both languages are green. we'll draft but not publish.

publish-bot: canary-js-4145678901 deployed to canary (5% traffic).

anita_eng: starting py canary now. will watch for packaging warnings.

publish-bot: canary-py-4145678920 uploaded -> artifact verification failed: checksum mismatch for wheel file.

zara_devex: whoops. pausing py pipeline. decision needed: pin py dist-tag to previous stable (2.7.4) and continue with JS only, or try immediate republish?

mike_releases: prefer pin + quick postmortem. we shouldn't risk GA with checksum mismatch. I'll open a dist-tag pin PR and notify support.

anita_eng: I can regenerate the wheel and run the signing step; ETA 18m. but only if we stop additional py publishes.

zara_devex: decision: pin python dist-tag to 2.7.4 now, proceed with JS canary/GA flow. open PR to pin and add rollback criteria. I'll notify support and docs.

mike_releases: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1209  pin python dist-tag to 2.7.4 and note rollback steps.

support-bot: support notification sent to #support: "Python dist-tag pinned to 2.7.4 due to artifact verification failure. Avoid pulling canary wheels."

anita_eng: repackaging done locally and signed. will push to staging and re-run verification.

publish-bot: canary-republish-4145678955 for @redwood/sdk-py artifact verification passed -> deployed to canary (3% traffic).

marta_docs: when you unpin tomorrow morning, ping me and I'll cut the release note and changelog.

zara_devex: final: leave dist-tag pinned until main window tomorrow. mark INF-2273 for post-release follow-up. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
